By now, you most likely have all of the level 1 Fusions for Yuri. If you don't,
I STRONGLY recommend getting them now. Heck, if you feel like it, feel free to
level them up to level 2, even though you won't be able to get any level 2
Fusions until a little later on.

Even though the Temple Ruins "collapsed", for some reason you can still go back
and go through all three of the mazes. As I mentioned before, the three areas
of the Temple Ruins hold an enemy of each class.

 - If you're needing the Fire or Wind Fusions, then go through the western door
   in the first room of the maze and fight in that area.

 - If you're needing the Light Fusion or want some more Dark Soul Energy, then
   go through the eastern door in the first room of the maze and fight in that
   area.

 - If you're needing the Water Fusion or want some more Earth Soul Energy, then
   you'll need to proceed all the way through the first western maze until you
   reach the second one. You can fight the enemies in here for those classes.

 - If you're wanting to grind for levels while doing this and want a challenge,
   then you may want to go to the Kowloon Fortress. It also has an enemy of
   each class, but they don't come in groups like they do at the Temple Ruins.
   They are also harder, so it's up to you.

Once you have enough Soul Energy to unlock the Fusions, visit the Graveyard and
take each one on, one at a time.

|                                                                             |
|  Rather than list each sub-boss separately, I'm covering them all in this   |
|  one section, since each one requires basically the same strategy.          |
|                                                                             |
|  Each of their HP varies depending on Yuri, so if he's weaker, they'll be   |
|  weaker as well, and vice versa.                                            |
|                                                                             |
|  If you have the Fusion with the class opposite of one already, fuse into   |
|  that monster and use its highest powered magic spell against them for      |
|  major damage. If you don't, then just fuse into the Raging Tiger and wail  |
|  on them with normal attacks for a few rounds. Make sure to keep yourself   |
|  healed if you fear that you'll be taken down fairly easily.                |
|                                                                             |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'

On to the next side quest! I believe that it's more beneficial to take on
Kowloon Fortress before trying Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight, so let's do that first.
